description: In a nonempty Dedekind-complete dense linear order without endpoints, every order isomorphism from an order-dense subset to the rationals extends uniquely to an order isomorphism to the reals.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DenseLinearOrders.dense_identification_extension.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [Nonempty α]
  [DenselyOrdered α] [NoMinOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α] (hc : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DenseLinearOrders.DedekindComplete α)
  (D : Set α) (hD : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DenseLinearOrders.OrderDense D) (e : ↑D ≃o ℚ) : ∃! f, ∀ (d : ↑D), f ↑d = ↑(e d)
